Spira has been a trusted partner to the EMC community since 1978, delivering precision-engineered solutions for Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) and Radio-Frequency Interference (RFI) shielding. With a strong focus on quality, reliability, and customer service, Spira continues to set industry standards for performance and innovation in shielding products. We proudly offer the finest and most reliable EMI/RFI shielding gaskets and honeycomb filters on the market, at very competitive prices. The strength of Spira lies in our exceptional products, on-time delivery, superior customer service, and technical support.
